name: OAHAssessmentMetrics
title: OneAquaHealth Assessment Metrics & Corroboration Subcomponents
publisher: OneAquaHealth Consortium - Semantic Interoperability Working Group
description: Standardized metrics and decomposition sub-scores used in multi-source environmental evidence fusion.

concept.definition: Normalized composite multi-source corroboration score (range 0.00–1.00) measuring empirical evidence support.
Normalized index (0.00–1.00) reflecting congruence and severity among calibrated physical-chemical sensor probes.
Normalized index (0.00–1.00) quantifying density, spatial concordance, and consensus of citizen science field reports.
Normalized index (0.00–1.00) evaluating persistence and multi-timestep trend consistency of the environmental anomaly.
